sents.t: It is Friday.
My interview is at ten thirty, but I am awake at five o’clock!
I am too nervous to sleep.
At six fifteen, I take a shower.
At seven, I eat toast and an egg.
At seven thirty, I put on my best shirt.
Then I look at the clock.
It is only seven forty-five!
I practice my answers: “My name is Sam. I love books. I can work on weekends.”
At nine o’clock, I leave my apartment.
The bookstore is a twenty-minute walk from my home, so I am early.
I wait at Maple Café.
Lily gives me a small coffee.
“Good luck, Sam!”
At ten twenty-five, I open the door of the bookstore.
Mr. Lee is a tall man with a kind face.
“You are right on time,” he says.
The interview is thirty minutes long.
Mr. Lee asks many questions, and I answer them all.
At eleven o’clock, he shakes my hand.
“Can you start on Monday at nine?”
“Yes, I can!” I say.
I have a job!

comp.q: Why is Sam awake at five o’clock?
comp.fa: چرا سام ساعت پنج بیدار است؟

comp.q: What does Sam eat for breakfast?
How long is the walk to the bookstore?
comp.fa: پیاده‌روی تا کتاب‌فروشی چقدر طول می‌کشد؟
چه کسی به سام قهوه می‌دهد؟

comp.q: When does Sam start his new job?
comp.fa: سام کی کار جدیدش را شروع می‌کند؟
